title: Read Google search results without tripping CAPTCHA
task: Extract result titles and URLs for a query across several profiles.
caveats: One signed-in profile hit a CAPTCHA after roughly 35 queries; three profiles together after roughly 75. Spread load across profiles and add cooldowns, and stop when a CAPTCHA appears.
Scraping Google results may breach its terms; use this only where that is acceptable to you.
author: jeet-dhandha
